title: sapptest finding
description: Validates the YAML front matter of a findings/F-NNNN-<slug>.md file, read as a JSON object. Findings are live state: a fixed finding is deleted, so there is no closed status.

id.description: Stable ID minted per PLAYBOOK.md C1 (cksum of id_key mod 10000).

id_key.description: Hash input: '<primary file>|<title-slug>'. Never changes after minting, even if the title is reworded.

severity.description: Per config/severity.yml definitions. Judge impact, not effort.

status.description: Always open; fixed findings are deleted by the verifying audit.

files.description: Repo-relative paths. First entry is the primary file used in id_key.

refactor.description: true = the refactor procedure may open a PR applying suggested_fix.

repro.description: Steps or trace that demonstrates the issue. For non-bug categories: how to observe it.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete enough to apply without re-deriving the analysis.
